4. Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to the respondents through all permissible modes.
In the meanwhile, TCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.
This is an application preferred by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

The application is disposed of by directing the appellant to deposit 60% of the awarded amount with the learned Tribunal, within a period of six weeks, with a further direction to the learned Tribunal to release the same in favour of the claimants as per the scheme of disbursal contained in the impugned award.
